# FG-CI-0007

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 503 |
| 重大度 | warn |
| Runbook | [`ci-runner`](../../ops/runbooks/ci-runner.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `a_podman_error_exit_is_container_start_failed` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: CI のジョブのコンテナを起動できませんでした。ジョブは失敗として報告されました。
- en: The CI job's container could not be started. The job was reported as failed.
- id: Kontainer tugas CI tidak dapat dijalankan. Tugas dilaporkan gagal.

## 原因 (cause)

M4 C4 (plan 14, ADR-0029): `forge-runner` runs each job in a throwaway rootless Podman container (`podman run --rm --network=none --read-only …`, argv only). Podman itself failed before the job's script ran: it exited 125 (its own error: the image could not be pulled from the internal mirror or its digest is unknown, the storage is full, the user namespace is not set up), or could not be started at all (the `podman` binary is missing or not executable). Also the runner host itself: the host is not rootless or the runner runs as root (it refuses to run jobs), or the job directory could not be created, written or removed (`workspace_unusable` / `workspace_dirty`: the runner then takes no further job). Not a fault of the job's script (that is a plain `failed` result with its exit code; 126 / 127 from the container are the script's).

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The runner host (`journalctl -u forge-runner`, JSON) logs the failure once (warn) with `error_code`, `request_id` and in `context` `job_id`, `attempt`, `pipeline_id`, `project_id`, `reason` (`podman_exit` / `spawn_failed` / `not_rootless` / `runs_as_root` / `workspace_unusable` / `workspace_dirty`), `exit_code` and `podman_stderr` (the last 2 KiB of Podman's own stderr), or `path` for the job directory; the job's log ends with the same code. `forge-runner check` repeats the host checks. On the runner host (as the runner's user): `podman info --format '{{.Host.Security.Rootless}}'` (must be true), `podman image exists <image>`, `podman system df`.

## 対処 (fix)

Follow runbook ci-runner (Runner host): pull or mirror the image into the internal registry, free container storage (`podman system prune` as the runner's user), or repair the rootless setup (subuid / subgid ranges). Then retry the pipeline (gstn pipeline retry --project <id> <pipeline_id>).
